summary: Iteration 6 — Session 7 mega-update. Found and FIXED a critical routing bug: api.include_router(admin_router) + app.include_router(api) were called at line 1472-1473, BEFORE ~230 new endpoint definitions (email verification, resend-verification, admin notifications broadcast/ai-suggest, user notifications CRUD, /watches, /sellers/{id}/follow, /sellers/{id}/follow-status). Result: all brand-new endpoints returned 404. After moving include_router to the end of server.py, everything registers. Backend pytest: 19 passed, 2 skipped (data-dependent). Reset-password no longer 500 (verified end-to-end: forgot -> DB token -> reset -> login with new pwd). Resend email ACTUALLY sends now (email_sent:true returned) with SENDER_EMAIL=noreply@alhraj.online. Frontend smoke: /register + /reset-password each have 2 password inputs (confirm + strength), /verify-email renders, /flights shows 4 providers (Skyscanner/Wego/Kayak/Google Flights) + airport picker w/ Arabic names (الرياض RUH, دبي الدولي DXB).

minor.issue: Pytest test_forgot_then_reset_no_500 skipped because dev_reset_link is null when Resend actually sends; test framework can't intercept real emails. Verified manually via DB: 200 + login with new password works.
Test skipped because POST /api/listings required an enum/field we did not construct correctly (422). The self-watch 400-guard is present in code and covered by static read.

issues: Console hydration warning: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>.' Likely a country-select option rendering an inner span (flag+name). Cosmetic but SSR-style warning should be fixed by removing span from inside <option>.

action_items: Re-verify end-to-end UX flows for Session-7 features in a manual pass (share button copy-URL, ImageViewer close button, district dropdown with 'أخرى', reels buttons, chat deal-done confirm, profile menu items, admin reports تفاصيل, admin notifications AI suggest). Pytest already covers backend; frontend smoke confirmed pages load and key selectors exist.
Fix Auth.js hydration warning: <span> rendered inside <option> — move country flag/name out of <option> (use native text) or switch to a custom Select.

Consider moving `api.include_router(admin_router)` and `app.include_router(api)` to the very end of server.py and adding a comment to prevent regression. I already did this; guard it with a test that asserts each critical endpoint returns != 404.
Optional: expose reset token in dev response when RESEND_API_KEY is set but an override flag ENABLE_DEV_RESET_LINK=1 is present — so E2E tests can intercept it.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py had ~230 lines of endpoints registered AFTER include_router, making them unreachable via HTTP. This is a catastrophic and silent bug (no startup error, just 404 at request time). Add a unit test that hits /openapi.json and asserts the presence of every expected path so future regressions are caught immediately.
server.py is now 1774 lines — past the 700-line guideline. Split into modules: auth.py, admin.py, listings.py, notifications.py, watches.py, follows.py, email.py.

/api/admin/notifications/broadcast: when target='country' but country_code not provided, the code silently falls through to querying all non-banned users (because the condition is 'target==country AND country_code'). Should 400 on missing country_code.
/api/watches POST uses upsert — good. But response always returns {success:true} even if update_one matched 0 AND upsert:true created a new doc. Consider returning {created: bool}.
/api/auth/resend-verification returns {sent: false} silently when Resend fails — the UI has no way to distinguish 'already sent recently' from 'SMTP failure'. Consider returning explicit error.

rca_of_the_issue: Reproduction: POST /api/auth/resend-verification -> 404. Hypothesis: route not registered. Verified by grep: @admin_router/@api decorators at lines 1488+ are defined AFTER include_router calls at line 1472-1473. FastAPI captures a snapshot of routes at include_router time; anything added to the sub-router after inclusion does not propagate to the parent app. Fix: moved include_router statements to after the last endpoint definition (around line 1702). Validation: `curl /api/auth/verify-email?token=bad` now returns 400 (not 404), all 19 backend tests pass. Mitigation going forward: add a test that GETs /openapi.json and verifies each critical path is listed.
